integrity: Proof was reconstructed from the stated formulas, and finite numerical checks are corroboration, not a replacement for the analytic argument. No independent review or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the homogeneous infinite half-line, one irreversible Lindblad boundary sink, and a basis-position initial state; the exact spectral absorption integral is credited to Riberi. Global uniqueness is proved only for sufficiently large starting distance, not every finite distance. Infinite-time absorption is taken before any spatial or source-distance limit. Earlier implicit overlap remains possible.
title: Finite-distance strong-loss optimization for half-line quantum absorption
